attribution.title: Friendship between Hyena and Hare
attribution.author: Adapted Aesop's Fable
attribution.modified: テキスト抽出・画像リサイズ・JSON 正規化を実施

pages.text:
Hare and Hyena
were friends.
They decided
to farm potatoes
together.

They worked hard
on the farm.

After work,
Hare and Hyena
played together.

But sometimes
Hyena chased Hare.
Hare would
run away.

One day,
Hare asked,
"If you are my friend,
why do you chase me?"

Then Hare asked,
"But if you are
not my friend,
why do we work
and play together?"

A friend is someone
who is always a friend.
